name: Luxembourg
summary: EU citizens declare their arrival and get a registration certificate after three months. Non-EU nationals can get an investor permit with EUR 500,000 in a business (existing company with a 5-year commitment, or a new one creating 5 jobs in 3 years) or EUR 3 million in a management structure; a 'private reasons' permit for people living on their own resources, tied to the social minimum wage; or a Blue Card at EUR 65,652 a year. There is no digital nomad visa.
naturalisation: Five years of legal residence including the last year uninterrupted, a Luxembourgish language test (speaking A2, listening B1), a 'Living together in the Grand Duchy' course or exam, and a clean record.
dual_citizenship_note: Luxembourg does not require renunciation (secondary sources).

routes.name: EU/EEA/Swiss free movement
routes.summary: EU citizens declare arrival at the commune and get a registration certificate after 3 months.
routes.requirements: Directive 2004/38/EC; sufficient resources and health insurance for non-workers. Permanent residence after 5 years.

routes.name: Residence permit for investors (third-country nationals)
routes.summary: Three-year permit for investing at least EUR 500,000 in a Luxembourg business, or EUR 3 million in a management structure.
routes.requirements: Two-step procedure: ministerial approval from abroad, then permit application after arrival with a medical check. Options: EUR 500,000 in an existing company with a 5-year commitment to keep the investment and employment; EUR 500,000 in a new business creating at least 5 jobs within 3 years; EUR 3,000,000 in a management and investment structure. Permit valid 3 years, renewable. Legal basis: Law of 29 August 2008 as amended in 2017.
routes.physical_presence: Live in Luxembourg; permit renewable if conditions are kept

routes.investment_options: EUR 500,000 existing company (5-year commitment); EUR 500,000 new business with 5 jobs in 3 years; EUR 3,000,000 management and investment structure.
routes.family: Not covered on the page retrieved.
routes.tax_note: A permit does not set tax residence.

routes.name: Residence for private reasons (own resources)
routes.summary: Permit for people who can live on their own resources, such as a pension or income earned elsewhere in the EU/Schengen area, without working in Luxembourg.
routes.requirements: Resources must come from work in another EU/Schengen state or a pension, assessed against the monthly social minimum wage for unskilled workers (amount in 2026 not retrieved). Appropriate housing and health insurance. Case law and a 2022 bill tightened conditions; current text should be checked.

routes.tax_note: Luxembourg tax residence follows the effective abode / six-month rule.

routes.name: EU Blue Card (work)
routes.requirements: Gross annual salary at least EUR 65,652 for applications from 3 March 2026 (ministerial regulation of 23 February 2026; previously EUR 63,408), contract of at least 6 months, higher qualifications. Below the threshold a salaried-worker permit with labour-market test is needed.
